ceremony.name: Witnessed VRC with witness-share
ceremony.choreography: docs/25-ceremony-scenarios.md section 6.4: propose with witnessed true, the responder agrees; each party opens a witness session, submits a presentation bound to it and receives its credential; each shares it with the other (the receipt carries the credential's digest); each issues its relationship credential; no order between share and issue is asserted (docs/10 open question O7). The witness is the reference oracle in its labelled mode mint-on-verified, never the witness server.

scenarios.title: witnessed exchange in the order session, submit, share, issue: each party's credential is minted by the witness, shared and received, then issued; all three read completed
spec: docs/10-witness-share-profile.md sections 2, 4, 5 and 7 (the share, its receiver checks, the receipt carrying the credential's digest, the order session, share, issue as KW sends it; the order is open question O7, so no order is asserted)
TF specs/witness/session/0.1/spec.md (the session names its two parties; the issuer must be one of them)
TF specs/witness/session/submit/0.1/spec.md (the presentation is bound to the session challenge and domain; the response delivers the credential and is the outcome evidence)
TF specs/vrc/relationships/issue/0.1/spec.md:100-103 (the receipt digest is compared with the credential delivered)
docs/25-ceremony-scenarios.md section 6.4 (the witness is the reference oracle in the labelled mode mint-on-verified: a suite choice, not something the drafts require; the witness server was not run)
